whyMatters.en: Montreal collective; F♯ A♯ ∞ (1997) and Lift Your Skinny Fists (2000) set anarchic, field-recording post-rock as long-form composition.
whyMatters.zh: 蒙特利尔集体；F♯ A♯ ∞（1997）与 Lift Your Skinny Fists（2000）把无政府、田野录音式 post-rock 做成大型曲式。

shortBio.en: Instrumental post-rock ensemble; East Hastings is the early cinema-drone landmark.
shortBio.zh: 器乐 post-rock 大编制；East Hastings 是早期电影感持续音地标。

body.en:
Active from 1994 (name stylization varies). Early Constellation Records releases use spoken samples, tape hiss, and slow orchestral builds instead of verse-chorus.

East Hastings (1998 era circulation) and the Skinny Fists double album are reference points for European/US post-rock that rejects indie-song length. Membership is fluid; the method—crescendo architecture + found sound—is the constant.
body.zh:
自 1994 年活动（名称拼写多变）。早期 Constellation 厂牌作品用口语采样、磁带底噪与缓慢管弦渐强，而非主副歌。

East Hastings（约 1998 年流传）与 Skinny Fists 双专是欧美 post-rock 拒绝 indie 歌曲长度的参照。成员流动；方法——渐强结构 + 拾得声音——是常量。
